title: UDP or multicast output
description: The programme as MPEG-TS over UDP or RTP, to one receiver or a multicast group.

uri.title: Address
uri.description: Where to send: a multicast group such as udp://239.1.1.1:5000, or one receiver such as udp://192.168.1.50:5000. Write rtp:// instead of udp:// for receivers that want RTP (SMPTE 2022-2).

ttl.title: TTL
ttl.description: How many routers a multicast packet may cross. 1 keeps it on this network segment; raise it only when the receivers are across a router that forwards multicast.

interface.title: Network interface
interface.description: The interface multicast leaves by, by name: en0 or eth1. Leave empty to use the default route. Set it on a machine with a separate media network.

cbr_kbps.title: Constant bitrate
cbr_kbps.description: Pad the stream with null packets to exactly this rate and send it evenly, for hardware decoders and modulators that need a constant rate. Set it at least 10% above the programme's video and audio together. 0 sends what the programme makes.

packets_per_datagram.title: TS packets per datagram
packets_per_datagram.description: Seven 188 byte packets make 1316 bytes, which fits an ordinary 1500 byte network with room for the headers. Fewer only for a receiver that asks for it.

dscp.title: DSCP
dscp.description: The DiffServ class to mark packets with, for a network that prioritises media: 34 (AF41) for video is common. -1 leaves the system default.
